result.topic_en: Calculations on a Lamé-type second-order differential equation with a cubic coefficient $\Theta(x)$, its transformation via a Laplace-type integral into a third-order equation solved by power series, an elliptic substitution, and bibliographic notes on literature (Kummer, Heine, Dirichlet, Volkmann, Trendelenburg).
